notes: PHF HR Competition V1.2 — Result/Record contract + real-data import. (1) New participant-facing OPTIONAL field 'Ket qua thuc te / Ghi nhan' (payload.actual_result, existing jsonb column — no migration, fully backward-compatible with submissions that lack the key) shown after Cau tra loi/xu ly in Gui bai du thi / Bai cua toi / Cho duyet / Bang tin (all share qaFieldsHtml). (2) New reviewer-facing 'Ket qua / Ghi nhan cua giam khao' inline textarea on every review-queue item, wired through the EXISTING submissions.last_review_note / submission_history.reason columns (no new table) - available for approve/upgrade (optional) as well as request_revision/reject (still mandatory, same as before); score stays 100% reviewer-chosen, never derived from this text. Participant-facing 'Ghi chu nguoi duyet' display narrowed to needs_revision/rejected statuses only, so a reviewer's approve/upgrade assessment note never leaks to the participant. (3) Real historical data import: 5 real contributions from PHF_Competition_du_lieu_that_2026-09.csv imported into the live Production campaign 'Cau hoi & Cach tra loi Khach hang' (2 Dang Thi Diem / PHF041, 3 Nguyen Thi Le / PHF018, both resolved uniquely active against the real People Master) via the normal createDraft+submit path - auto-assigned to real reviewers, unscored, no fabricated reviewer/score, idempotent (safe to re-run, checks existing author+question before inserting). No changes to People Master identity, reviewer/admin grant semantics, self-review block, 2/5-point scoring, similarity thresholds, occurrences, feed/heart/leaderboard/publication, or campaign lifecycle. assets/css/phf-competition.css and assets/js/competition/phf-competition-app.js bumped to ?v=1.2.0_result_record_v1_2 in index.html (both already tracked in scripts/phf-check-js.js MANUAL_VERSIONED_ASSETS).
